findings: The approved card is not mechanically complete enough to implement its named position sizing without invention: the half-Kelly equation leaves p and b undefined, the 20-day annualized-volatility estimator omits return/variance conventions and invalid-data behavior, and the interaction between dynamic weight and the required fixed-risk backtest contract is unspecified.

The unchanged source does not implement volatility targeting or half-Kelly sizing at all. It also replaces the card's undefined 12-month exponential momentum with the endpoint difference Close[1]-Close[253], which is a materially different signal estimator.

Fresh build-gate hardening fails because the approved 2.0% realized-daily entry halt, 2.5% daily hard stop, and 5.0% total-drawdown stop are all absent. Entry-only rollover/spread filtering also precedes Strategy_ManageOpenPosition, so the approved Chandelier protection can be suspended while a position is open.
OnInit never calls QM_FrameworkDeclareExecutionContract after QM_FrameworkInit, so the approved D1 chart binding and Friday-close mode are not declared or checked fail-closed at runtime.

artifacts/qm5_37004_build_result.json reports smoke_result=framework_error, smoke_report_path=null, and a custom-history admission blocker. No valid smoke evidence exists, so the producer result fails the mandatory build-result contract even though the tracked MQ5/EX5 hashes identify a prior compile.
